evd_title: Full text input produced lower Spearman correlations than abstracts for all three ChatGPT models tested
finding: Full text input produced lower Spearman correlations than abstracts for all three ChatGPT models tested
P: 51 information science journal articles by the author, REF 1*-4* scores (single field)
I: GPT-3.5-turbo (API), zero-shot REF prompt, 30 iterations averaged; title vs abstract vs truncated full text
C: Author's own REF scores (1 rater); input-format ablation; GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini
O: Spearman r: abstracts 0.674, truncated text 0.625, titles 0.434
